author: Oldschoolgtafan
quote: I waited for a decade for GTA, but received a game that makes you do chores with a bad plot and worse NPC AI. This doesn’t feel like GTA to me. And it’s maxed at 30 fps, sometimes it goes very low like it was the wii-ew. And the glitches is as bad as sonic 006. Who approved this? $100 for a game this unpolished? On top of that, the critic review portion shows me that my once favorite game developer paid for the high scores. Rockstar needs to look into fixing my game for one, and for two, apologize for embarrassing me by paying for critic high scoring the game! Im no longer a fan. Forever OG GTA. Not this slop
